summary: Open Source Point of Sale (ospos): a CodeIgniter4 PHP retail POS web app managing items, inventory, customers, suppliers, employees with role grants, sales/quotations/returns, receivings/purchase orders, expenses, gift cards, loyalty reward points, taxes, attributes, cash-ups and app config.

_no_edges.why: public login endpoint; auth effect, not a guards edge; Login extends BaseController not Secure_Controller (Login.php:23)
public; destroys PHP session, no DB write, no guard (Home.php:39)
verifies current_password via check_password, then updates; not module-gated beyond 'home' (Home.php:76) — auth flows are treated separately
internal helper; reads-deletes giftcard row with only funds check, no auth (Giftcard.php:317)
section of register guarded only by 'sales' module; internally reads giftcard/customer balances (Sales.php:405)
receivings module guard; does undo of inventory + hard delete, no explicit grant (Receivings.php:288)
internal; called by Config controller which IS guarded by 'config' module; batch_save itself has no own wall (Appconfig.php:95)
